# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ A small utility to safely publish a blog article. """ import html # A simple template with placeholders for title and body. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Render a blog article safely for display. Parameters ---------- subject : str The heading of the blog post. description : str The main text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and formatted HTML string ready for safe display. """ # Validate arguments are strings if not isinstance(subject, str): raise TypeError("subject must be a string") if not isinstance(description, str): raise TypeError("description must be a string") # Escape HTML to prevent XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(subject, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Format using the predefined template formatted_article = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_article
